solution_files.src/two-fer.cob:
* Says who gets a cookie.
       IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. TWO-FER.
       AUTHOR. Ada.
       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01 WS-NAME    PIC X(16).
       01 WS-RESULT  PIC X(64).
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       TWO-FER.
      * Fall back to "you" if no name is given.
           IF WS-NAME = SPACES
               MOVE "One for you, one for me." TO WS-RESULT
           ELSE
               STRING "One for " DELIMITED BY SIZE
                      WS-NAME DELIMITED BY SPACE
                      ", one for me." DELIMITED BY SIZE
                      INTO WS-RESULT
           END-IF.

exercise_files.src/two-fer.cob:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. two-fer.
       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01 WS-NAME PIC X(16).
       01 WS-RESULT PIC X(64).
       
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       TWO-FER.
exercise_files.tst/two-fer/two-fer.cut:
TESTSUITE 'Tests for Two-Fer'

TestCase "No name given"
	PERFORM TWO-FER
	EXPECT WS-RESULT = "One for you, one for me."

TestCase "A name given"
	MOVE "Alice" TO WS-NAME
	PERFORM TWO-FER
	EXPECT WS-RESULT = "One for Alice, one for me."

TestCase "Another name given"
	MOVE "Keith" TO WS-NAME
	PERFORM TWO-FER
	EXPECT WS-RESULT = "One for Keith, one for me."
